MathJax 3.2.2, tex-svg combined component (unmodified upstream JavaScript).

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js
Project: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax/tree/3.2.2
License: Apache-2.0; see the accompanying LICENSE from the same release.
SHA-256 (tex-svg.js): d4295dc33744836935c1399feece5159577b34c5c8ffb9f1c6324cd82e03a882

The bundle includes SVG font data. Sphinx config disables automatic optional
TeX packages; the documentation uses base, AMS, newcommand, and noundefined.
No third-party CDN or font download is required for the displayed equations.
